Trains to Southport

This is the train I would look at for the Southport Air Show. Southport is the end of the Merseyrail Northern line, with trains from Liverpool Central every 15 minutes through the day, calling at Formby, Ainsdale, Birkdale and Hillside on the way. It’s the end of the line, so you can’t miss your stop, and the station is step free. From there it’s a flat 10 to 15 minute walk to the seafront.
